title: WAMTA short-course page data (shortcourse.yml)
description: Drives the per-year /shortcourse page rendered by _includes/shortcourse.md. All keys are optional so the file can stand as a commented-out template for years that did not host their own short course; an entirely-commented file (parses as null) is also accepted.

nav_hidden.description: When true, the page stays reachable but is omitted from the top navigation. Original WAMTA convention is to hide short-course pages even when they exist.

title.description: Page heading text (e.g. 'Short course: Modern STL Basics').

description.description: Multi-paragraph intro describing the course and instructor. Markdown allowed.

topics.description: Bulleted list of primary course topics.

additional_topics.description: Bulleted list of advanced / additional course topics.

logistics.description: Markdown block listing important dates, registration link, dates, etc.

show_contact.description: When true, renders the contact-us include below the short-course content.
